data.name: Step0_Desc
data.value: Move mail between Microsoft 365 tenants: one mailbox, several, or everyone.

data.name: Step1_Desc
data.value: Connect to the tenant you are copying FROM. It is only ever read; nothing in it is changed.

data.name: Step2_Desc
data.value: Connect to the tenant you are copying TO. Mail is added here; nothing already there is changed or deleted.

data.name: Step3_Desc
data.value: Pick the mailboxes to copy. Use the filters to narrow the list, then tick the ones you want.

data.name: Step4_Desc
data.value: Tell the tool which target mailbox each source mailbox goes into.

data.name: Step5_Desc
data.value: Choose how the mail lands in the target and which safety checks to run.

data.name: Step6_Desc
data.value: Check the plan. Nothing has been copied yet.

data.name: Step7_Desc
data.value: Copying now. You can stop at any time; finished items are remembered, so you can resume later.

data.name: Step8_Desc
data.value: What was copied, what was checked, and what to do next.

data.name: Hint_Source
data.value: Connect to the source tenant to continue.

data.name: Hint_Target
data.value: Connect to the target tenant to continue.

data.name: Hint_TickOne
data.value: Tick at least one mailbox to continue.

data.name: Hint_OneReady
data.value: At least one row must say Ready to continue.

data.name: Hint_EnterFolder
data.value: Enter a folder name to continue.

data.name: Hint_Filters
data.value: Check the mail filters: tick at least one folder, pick a date, and enter a size greater than 0.

data.name: Hint_Estimating
data.value: Estimating the size and time (read only). Start is available when it finishes, or choose Skip the estimate.

data.name: Hint_Understand
data.value: Tick the box above to continue.

data.name: Welcome_Intro
data.value: This tool copies mail between Microsoft 365 tenants. You can move one mailbox, a chosen few, or everyone, and it checks every message against the original afterward.

data.name: Welcome_WillTitle
data.value: What it will and will not do

data.name: Welcome_WillBody
data.value: • The source tenant is only ever read. Nothing in it is changed or deleted. • The target only ever receives items (mail, and calendar events and contacts if you choose). The tool never deletes or changes anything already there. • A message copied twice is skipped, so a run can be repeated or resumed safely. • Every copied message is compared with its source, field by field, and the result is reported.

data.name: Welcome_NeedTitle
data.value: What you need before you start

data.name: Welcome_NeedBody
data.value: 1. An app registration in each tenant (source and target), set up by a global administrator. The next steps show exactly which permissions to add. 2. A client secret for each registration. 3. The mailboxes you want to move must already exist in the target tenant (create the users and give them licenses first).

data.name: Welcome_HowBody
data.value: The tool uses the app registration, not a person's sign-in, so it can reach other people's mailboxes without their passwords. Because an app registration with these permissions can reach every mailbox in its tenant, keep its secret private and remove the registration when the migration is finished.

data.name: Welcome_NextHint
data.value: Select Next to connect the source tenant. You can come back to any finished step from the step bar at the top.

data.name: Conn_SourceIntro
data.value: The source is the tenant the mail currently lives in. Smart Mailbox Copy signs in with an app registration (no person signs in) and reads the mailboxes you choose.

data.name: Conn_TargetIntro
data.value: The target is the tenant the mail is moving to. The mailboxes must already exist there, with licenses. The tool only adds mail.

data.name: Conn_SourcePermsIntro
data.value: In the Microsoft Entra admin center: App registrations > your app > API permissions > Add a permission > Microsoft Graph > Application permissions. Then select Grant admin consent.

data.name: Conn_TargetPermsIntro
data.value: Same place as for the source: API permissions > Add a permission > Microsoft Graph > Application permissions, then Grant admin consent.

data.name: Conn_PermNoteExport
data.value: export; use the export permission if the portal lists one

data.name: Conn_RegHint
data.value: The saved Microsoft Entra app registration for this tenant. If it is not in the list yet, choose Manage and add it.

data.name: Conn_TestNote
data.value: This signs in with the app registration, reads the list of mailboxes, and checks which application permissions the app has been granted. It changes nothing. A permission you added a moment ago can take a few minutes to show up: wait, then connect again.

data.name: Conn_SecretMissing
data.value: NO client secret saved: add one under Manage

data.name: Conn_Connected
data.value: Connected. Accounts with a mailbox address found: {0}.

data.name: Conn_NoSecret
data.value: This registration has no client secret saved on this PC. Choose Manage and add it.

data.name: Err_SecretInvalid
data.value: The client secret is not valid. It may be the secret's ID instead of its Value, or a different app's secret. Create a new secret and update it under Manage.

data.name: Err_SecretExpired
data.value: The client secret has expired. Create a new one and update it under Manage.

data.name: Err_ClientNotFound
data.value: That application (client) ID was not found in this tenant. Check the tenant and client IDs under Manage.

data.name: Err_TenantNotFound
data.value: That tenant ID was not found. Check it under Manage.

data.name: Err_MissingUserRead
data.value: The app is missing the User.Read.All application permission, or admin consent has not been granted.

data.name: Chk_Header
data.value: Application permissions granted to this app:

data.name: Chk_WhyContacts
data.value: only to copy additional contact folders

data.name: Chk_AddMissing
data.value: Add the missing permissions as Application permissions and grant admin consent. They can take a few minutes to appear.

data.name: Boxes_Intro
data.value: Show the kinds of mailbox you want, narrow by domain or text, then tick the ones to copy. Your ticks are kept while you change the filters. Unlicensed accounts are shared, room or equipment mailboxes; Microsoft does not say which.

data.name: Boxes_SelectionHidden
data.value: · {0} selected but hidden by the filters

data.name: Match_Intro
data.value: Each source address needs a mailbox in the target tenant. They are matched by swapping the domain; type a different target address in any row where the names differ. Rows that say Ready will be copied; the others are left out.

data.name: Match_ApplyDomain
data.value: Match all rows to this domain

data.name: Match_NotFound
data.value: Not found in the target tenant

data.name: Match_SummaryLeft
data.value: · {0} will be left out until fixed

data.name: Match_Imported
data.value: {0} of {1} rows in the file matched a mailbox you selected. The others were ignored.

data.name: Opt_PimOnly
data.value: Calendar events and contacts only (do not copy any mail)

data.name: Opt_PimOnlyNote
data.value: A good first test, or a way to copy calendars separately. Events go into each target mailbox's default Calendar and contacts into its default Contacts. This adds items permanently: the tool cannot remove them afterward.

data.name: Opt_Container
data.value: Mail only, into one new folder in each target mailbox (recommended)

data.name: Opt_ContainerNote
data.value: All the mail, folder structure included, is copied into a single new folder. Safest, and easy to review or delete in Outlook before anyone starts using the mailbox. Calendar events and contacts cannot be placed in it, so they are not copied in this mode.

data.name: Opt_Merge
data.value: Merged into the real folders, with calendar and contacts

data.name: Opt_MergeNote
data.value: Mail lands where the person expects it (Inbox into Inbox, Sent Items into Sent Items) and the other folders are recreated beside them. This adds items permanently: the tool has no way to remove them afterward.

data.name: Opt_IncludePim
data.value: Also copy calendar events and contacts (the default and any additional calendars and contact folders)

data.name: Opt_IncludePimNote
data.value: Untick to copy mail only. Events, including recurring meetings, are counted but not yet compared field by field.

data.name: Opt_LimitNone
data.value: Limit what is copied (optional): nothing is limited, everything is copied

data.name: Opt_LimitSome
data.value: Limit what is copied (optional): limits turned on: {0}

data.name: Opt_LimitIntro
data.value: By default every folder and every message is copied. Use these only to copy less. They apply to every mailbox, never to calendar events and contacts, and left-out mail is never changed or deleted in the source.

data.name: Opt_LeaveOutNote
data.value: A folder that is left out takes its subfolders with it.

data.name: Opt_DateFilter
data.value: Only mail created on or after

data.name: Opt_DateNote
data.value: This is the day each message was created in the mailbox, which is normally the day it arrived. Check a sample after the first copy.

data.name: Opt_Dedupe
data.value: Skip mail that is already in the target (so a re-run cannot create duplicates)

data.name: Opt_Verify
data.value: Compare every copied message with its source afterward (adds time, recommended)

data.name: Opt_AllowNonEmpty
data.value: Allow target folders that already contain items (the copied items are added alongside them)

data.name: Opt_AllowNonEmptyNote
data.value: Merging refuses to start when a target folder, such as the Inbox or Calendar, already holds items, unless this is ticked.

data.name: Opt_Fresh
data.value: Start over: ignore what earlier runs already copied (the duplicate check above still protects the target mail)

data.name: Opt_LeaveOutCalTitle
data.value: Calendars and contact folders to leave out

data.name: Opt_LeaveOutCalNote
data.value: One name per line, exactly as it appears in Outlook. Additional calendars and contact folders with these names are not copied; a contact folder takes its subfolders with it. Use it for calendars people subscribe to, such as a holiday calendar. The Birthdays calendar is never copied (Outlook builds it from contacts). The default Calendar and Contacts are not affected.

data.name: Opt_ProtectedTitle
data.value: Mailboxes that must never be written to

data.name: Opt_ProtectedNote
data.value: One address per line. If one of these is chosen as a target, the copy for it is refused.

data.name: Rev_PimOnly
data.value: Only calendar events and contacts are copied, into each target mailbox's default Calendar and Contacts. No mail is copied.

data.name: Rev_Merge
data.value: Mail goes into each target mailbox's real folders (Inbox, Sent Items, Drafts…); other folders are recreated beside them.

data.name: Rev_Container
data.value: Mail only goes into a new folder named "{0}" in each target mailbox, folder structure included.

data.name: Rev_LeftOutCal
data.value: Calendars and contact folders left out by name: {0}.

data.name: Rev_PimYes
data.value: Calendar events and contacts: copied into each target mailbox's default Calendar and Contacts.

data.name: Rev_PimNo
data.value: Calendar events and contacts: not copied.

data.name: Rev_DedupeOn
data.value: Mail already in the target is skipped.

data.name: Rev_DedupeOff
data.value: Mail already in the target is NOT checked for.

data.name: Rev_Since
data.value: Only mail created on or after {0}.

data.name: Rev_MaxSize
data.value: Messages larger than {0} MB are skipped.

data.name: Rev_VerifyOn
data.value: Every copied message is compared with its source afterward.

data.name: Rev_Sequential
data.value: Mailboxes are copied one after another. Nothing in the source is changed.

data.name: Rev_WarnLeft
data.value: Mailboxes left out because no matching target mailbox was found: {0}. Go back to Match mailboxes to fix them.

data.name: Rev_WarnResource
data.value: Selected mailboxes with no license (shared, room or equipment): {0}. Their mail folders are copied, and so is their calendar when calendar copying is on. Resource settings such as booking policies are not.

data.name: Rev_WarnMergePim
data.value: This adds calendar events and contacts permanently. This tool has no way to remove them.

data.name: Rev_WarnMerge
data.value: Merging adds items to the real folders permanently. This tool has no way to remove them.

data.name: Rev_Understand
data.value: I understand that merging adds mail to the real folders and this tool cannot remove it.

data.name: Est_NeedsConn
data.value: An estimate needs the connections from the earlier steps.

data.name: Est_Reading
data.value: Reading the size of the mailboxes ({0}); read only, nothing is changed…

data.name: Est_Skipped
data.value: Estimate skipped. The progress bar will still show an estimate once the copy is under way.

data.name: Est_Failed
data.value: The estimate could not be made: {0}

data.name: Est_Basis
data.value: Based on speeds measured in our tests with ordinary messages; very large attachments take longer. Mailboxes are copied one after another. If you stop, the next run resumes where it left off.

data.name: Est_Unreadable
data.value: Mailboxes that could not be read: {0}. They are not in the estimate and will probably fail in the copy too. First reason: {1}

data.name: Phase_1
data.value: Sign in and verify the accounts

data.name: Phase_2
data.value: Source (read-only): walk the folder tree and list items

data.name: Phase_3
data.value: Target: locate the folders the mail goes into

data.name: Phase_4
data.value: Recreate the tree and copy items (export from source, import into target)

data.name: Phase_5
data.value: Reconcile: compare item counts per folder

data.name: Phase_6
data.value: Verify: compare every copied message with its source, field by field

data.name: Res_CompleteVerified
data.value: Mailboxes copied: {0}. Every one of the {1} messages checked was identical to its source.

data.name: Res_StoppedEarlySub
data.value: Mailboxes finished: {0}. Not started: {1}. Run again to continue: finished items are not copied twice.

data.name: Res_NeedLook
data.value: Finished, with items that need a look

data.name: Next_Problems
data.value: Open the results file or the log to see why, fix the cause (for example a missing permission or a target mailbox that does not exist yet), and choose Run again. Finished items are remembered, so nothing is copied twice.

data.name: Next_SpotMerge
data.value: Open a few target mailboxes in Outlook and check the Inbox, Sent Items and your own folders. Spot-check messages with attachments.

data.name: Next_SpotContainer
data.value: Open a few target mailboxes in Outlook and look for the folder "{0}". Spot-check messages with attachments. People can move mail out of it, or leave it there.

data.name: Next_Pim
data.value: Contacts and calendar are counted but not yet compared field by field. Open the Contacts and Calendar in a few target mailboxes and check them, recurring meetings especially.

data.name: Next_Rerun
data.value: To pick up mail that arrived after this run, choose Run again with the same settings. Only new mail is copied.

data.name: Next_Cleanup
data.value: When the migration is completely finished, delete the client secrets and remove the app registrations in Microsoft Entra, since they can reach every mailbox in the tenant.

data.name: Sum_Line
data.value: Mailboxes copied: {0} of {1}; messages copied: {2}; already in target: {3}; failed items: {4}; time: {5}.

data.name: Sum_LineVerified
data.value: Mailboxes copied: {0} of {1}; messages copied: {2}; already in target: {3}; failed items: {4}; verified identical: {5} of {6}; time: {7}.

data.name: Reg_Intro
data.value: An app registration is the identity this tool uses to talk to Microsoft 365 in a tenant. You create it once per tenant in the Microsoft Entra admin center, then save it here under a name you recognize and pick it on the Source and Target steps. Nothing here is sent anywhere; it is stored for your Windows user only.

data.name: Reg_NameHint
data.value: Anything that helps you tell them apart, for example "Contoso (source)".

data.name: Reg_TenantHint
data.value: A GUID. On the registration's Overview page in the Entra admin center.

data.name: Reg_ClientHint
data.value: A GUID. Also on the Overview page.

data.name: Reg_SecretHint
data.value: The secret's Value (not its ID), from Certificates & secrets. It lets the app copy mailboxes without anyone signing in. It is encrypted for your Windows user and cannot be read on another PC. It is shown only as it is typed; type a new one to replace it.

data.name: Reg_SetupHelp
data.value: To create one: Microsoft Entra admin center > App registrations > New registration (single tenant). Open API permissions and add the Application permissions shown on the Source and Target steps, then Grant admin consent. Open Certificates & secrets, create a New client secret, and copy its Value straight away (it is shown only once). Copy the Directory (tenant) ID and Application (client) ID from the Overview page into this form.

data.name: Reg_RemoveText
data.value:
Remove "{0}" from this list?
This only forgets it here. The app registration in Microsoft Entra is not touched.

data.name: Reg_NeedGuid
data.value: "{0}": the tenant ID and the client ID must both be GUIDs (for example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000).

data.name: Set_LanguageNote
data.value: A new language takes effect the next time you start Smart Mailbox Copy.
